specName: Start and continue a bug or an idea from Companion

FR-001.title: A + action on each pane opens its create screen

FR-002.title: New Bug collects symptom, optional link or error, slug, and sends bug assess

FR-003.title: New Idea collects idea, optional audience, slug, and sends assess intake

FR-004.title: Slug is derived, normalised, non-empty and unique

FR-005.title: Nothing is sent with an empty required field; typed text survives a failed dispatch

FR-006.title: The + action offers the extension install when it is missing

FR-007.title: Bug page footer buttons follow the bug state

FR-008.title: Idea page buttons follow the stage and verdict

FR-009.title: Create spec from this idea opens Create Spec prefilled

FR-010.title: Buttons follow the files without reopening the page

FR-011.title: Pages stay read-only apart from the buttons

FR-012.title: Typed text reaches the assistant as prompt text only

FR-013.title: Docs describe starting and continuing bugs and ideas

expectations: No new look for the bug or idea pages
No recorded link between an idea and its spec
No run record for bugs or ideas
context: area: apps/vscode/src/features/spec-editor and apps/vscode/webview/src/spec-editor (the Create Spec screen and its submit path)
area: apps/vscode/src/features/spec-viewer and apps/vscode/webview/src/spec-viewer (the read-only report panel footer and its message allow-list)
area: apps/vscode/src/features/bugs, ideas, processes and package.json (pane title actions, commands)
constraint: a natural-language prompt dispatches through executeInTerminal, never executeSlashCommand
constraint: never interpolate user data into an HTML attribute or a shell command
constraint: a read-only panel message allow-list gates what a report panel may send
constraint: row and button values come from allow-listed state, never raw file text
intent: Start a bug or an idea from its pane and move it through its steps with footer buttons

decisions.decision: A second small webview for New Bug and New Idea
decisions.why: Create Spec wires image, workflow and paste handlers unconditionally and holds one panel
decisions.rejected: A mode on the Create Spec panel

decisions.decision: Typed text goes into a file; the prompt holds the command, the slug and the file path
decisions.why: cmd.exe places the prompt on the command line, so typed text there would reach a shell
decisions.rejected: Sending the text as prompt text

decisions.decision: Footer buttons are computed from the files and a click sends only an id
decisions.why: A read-only panel must not be able to send a command or a slug
decisions.rejected: Reusing enhancement buttons, which carry a command

decisions.decision: Create Spec accepts an optional description
decisions.why: A go idea becomes a spec only when the developer sends it
decisions.rejected: Creating the spec directly from the idea

decisions.decision: A report folder whose name is not plain letters, digits, dots, underscores or dashes is not dispatched
decisions.why: The folder name goes into the prompt, and a hand-made name with spaces or shell characters must not

decisions.decision: The create screen has its own classes in the Create Spec stylesheet
decisions.why: Inline styles were a stopgap from a worker that could not edit the shared stylesheet

decisions.decision: A prefill sent to a hidden Create Spec panel waits for its reload
decisions.why: A hidden panel has no live webview to receive a message

plan.summary: A create screen, state-derived footer buttons on report panels, and a Create Spec prefill
plan.key_finding: Report panels have no footer at all today, and the read-only allow-list is what keeps them from dispatching

tasks.summary: 14 tasks: Foundational (3), US1 (4), US2 (4), US3 (1), Polish (2)

implement.summary: New Bug and New Idea screens, state-derived footer buttons on report pages, and a Create Spec prefill

approach: A small create webview writes the typed text to a file and sends the assess command with a cleaned slug. Report panels get a footer whose buttons the extension derives from the files; a click sends an id that is re-checked against the item before the matching command is dispatched. Create Spec gains an optional prefill for a go idea.
